title: 1991 AHSME Problem 25
statement: If \(T_n=1+2+3+\cdots+n\) and \[ \begin{aligned} P_n&=\frac{T_2}{T_2-1} \cdot\frac{T_3}{T_3-1}\\ &\quad\cdot\frac{T_4}{T_4-1} \cdots\frac{T_n}{T_n-1} \end{aligned} \] for \(n=2,\) \(3,\) \(4,\) \(\ldots,\) then \(P_{1991}\) is closest to which of the following numbers?

solutions.text:
Since \(T_k=\frac{k(k+1)}{2}\) and \(T_k-1=\frac{(k-1)(k+2)}{2},\) \[ \frac{T_k}{T_k-1} =\frac{k}{k-1}\cdot\frac{k+1}{k+2}. \] The product telescopes: \[ \begin{aligned} P_n &=\left(\prod_{k=2}^n\frac{k}{k-1}\right) \left(\prod_{k=2}^n\frac{k+1}{k+2}\right)\\ &=n\cdot\frac3{n+2}\\ &=\frac{3n}{n+2}. \end{aligned} \] For \(n=1991,\) this is just under \(3\) and is closest to \(2.9.\)

Thus the correct answer is D.
